data.narrative:
Archetype AI is a Series A AI & Software company that has raised $48M to date. The valuation analysis draws on a comparable universe of 9 private companies and 1 public peer (Palantir, ticker PLTR), including same-stage and adjacent-stage companies such as Scale AI, Reflection AI, Physical Intelligence, and Black Forest Labs.

Two triangulation methods were applied. The Stage-Progression method, using the $48M total raised as a proxy for current value and applying a 2.0x multiplier typical of Series A to next-stage progression, implies a valuation of $96M. The Peer-Median method benchmarks against four same-sector, same/adjacent-stage comparables with a median valuation of $15.3B, though the peer set spans a wide range from $3.2B (Black Forest Labs) to $29.0B (Scale AI). This wide dispersion reflects the heterogeneity within early-stage AI companies.

The two methods produce substantially divergent results. The Stage-Progression approach yields $96M, while Peer-Median yields $15.3B. The triangulated analysis supports a range of $82M (low) to $17.6B (high), with a median of $7.7B. The wide valuation band reflects material uncertainty around whether Archetype AI's market position and technical differentiation merit positioning near the lower bound defined by stage-adjusted capital deployment or closer to the peer median. Key uncertainties include revenue traction, technical defensibility relative to named peers, and the sustainability of current-stage AI company valuations.
